concept: DR strategies: Backup & Restore for relaxed RTO/RPO
tests: Choosing the cheapest DR strategy that meets an RTO of 4 h and an RPO of 1 h.
expected: Backup & Restore via AWS Backup: hourly backups (RPO 1 h) with cross-Region copy, infrastructure rebuilt within 4 h. Triggers: "hours of downtime acceptable", "lowest possible cost".
why_not: Pilot Light and Warm Standby also fit but cost more due to always-running resources; Multi-Site Active/Active is the most expensive and overkill.
